references.text: Micah offered the Levite to be his father and priest, the same title and role that the Danites now offer him.
The Levite explained how Micah had hired him as a priest, something the Danites now wish to take over.
Joseph became like a father to Pharaoh; the same term 'father' is used here for a spiritual advisor and leader.
Job describes himself as a father to the poor, using 'father' in the same way as an honorific title for one who provides guidance.
Eliakim shall be like a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem; this parallels the use of 'father' as a spiritual leader.
The spies tell about the ephod, the household gods, and the carved image that were in the house, which the Danites now wish to take along with the priest.
